questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In geography class, / the teacher told the students, / "Switzerland lies / inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy."

options.text: inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment **"inside Germany, France, Austria, and Italy" **is incorrect.
 
• The **correct preposition to use here is "between" or "among" rather than "inside".**
 
• **Switzerland **is not located inside these countries but is bordered by them.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should correctly state: **"Switzerland lies between Germany, France, Austria, and Italy."**

Hence, the correct answer is 'option 4.'

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

There are eight planets in our solar system and a Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

options.text: and a Earth is the third

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the article 'a' is incorrect.
 
• The correct article to use before the word **'Earth'** is **'the'** because Earth is a **unique object.**
 
• Example: ***The Earth is the third planet from the Sun.***
 
• Therefore, the article 'a' should be replaced with the article 'the'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***There are eight planets in our solar system and the Earth __is the third planet from the Sun.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• If a noun is **unique or one of a kind**, the **definite article 'the'** is used before it.

 
 
• Example: ***The Sun** rises in the east.*
 
 
 
• When referring to **planets** or **celestial bodies** by name, the **definite article 'the'** is usually used.
 
 
• Example: ***The Mars **rover is sending back data.*

questions.question: Rohan can alone finish a work in 12 days and Hari can alone in 16 days. They both work for 3 days and then Rohan left. After that only Hari works and finishes the work. The total work will be completed in:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let T be the total duration of the work (time Hari worked).

Fractional work equation: (Rohan time ÷ Rohan total) + (Hari time ÷ Hari total) = 1.

(3 ÷ 12) + (T ÷ 16) = 1

1/4 + T/16 = 1 ⇒ T/16 = 3/4.

T = (3 × 16) ÷ 4 = 12 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Rohan alone = 12 days, Hari alone = 16 days. They work together for 3 days.

Formula: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken.

⇒ x = [8 ± sqrt(64 + 80)]/2

⇒ x = [8 ± sqrt(144)]/2

⇒ x = [8 ± 12]/2

ii. GR technology had penetrated more in wheat crop than in the rice crop.

iii. During post GR period, the area under rice achieved a relatively slow growth when compared to the area under wheat.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only ii and iii**__

• **GR technology had penetrated more in wheat crop than in the rice crop.**
